content: {"episode_id":"ep-05163","cpt":"93226","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93226, the 48-hour Holter monitoring study, for episode ep-05163. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with a history of recurrent palpitations consistent with supraventricular tachycardia, accompanied by episodes of dizziness and a recent event of syncope, matching diagnosis codes I47.1, R42, and R55. Per the indication note, the 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management. We request reconsideration of the outstanding balance of 153.07 based on this documentation."}
